routes.label: Starboard side
routes.detail: Batteries, then Korrag, then the Helm.

routes.label: Through the Barracks
routes.detail: Batteries, Barracks, Korrag, Helm. The tied-up soldiers stay tied up.

routes.label: Barracks, soldiers freed
routes.detail: As through the Barracks, but they pour a potion into each of the 4 soldiers, who then fight with them to the end.

routes.label: The lower deck
routes.detail: The lower deck (4 Snatchers) instead of the batteries, then Korrag, then the Helm.

crystal.label: Never found
crystal.detail: They never rest in the crystal room.

crystal.label: Found early
crystal.detail: One long rest there after their first fight, none later.

crystal.label: Only before the bridge
crystal.detail: Doors locked from most sides: they reach it only just before the Helm, and rest there once.

crystal.label: Rest between every fight
crystal.detail: They find it early and come back to rest after every room.

foes.label: As written
foes.detail: Targets as the scene describes, Silas leaves when it turns.

foes.label: All on Devan
foes.detail: Everyone hits Devan first, and Silas leaves early.

foes.label: Soft targets
foes.detail: They go for Swift and Cassian first.

foes.label: Ruthless
foes.detail: Soft targets first, and Silas never leaves.
